summary.name: Eye Shape Detector
summary.one_liner: An AI web tool that analyzes an uploaded photo to classify your eye shape and offer beauty and style recommendations.
use_cases: Find your eye shape from a selfie
Select eyewear frames that suit your eyes
Balance eyebrow shape with eye type
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI detector that takes an uploaded photo and reviews eye opening, outer-corner angle, eyelid crease, visible lid space, and the distance between the eyes. It matches these features to shape categories such as almond, round, hooded, upturned, downturned, wide-set, close-set, deep-set, and protruding. It reports a primary match plus secondary possibilities, since features often overlap. The result is intended as a beauty and style reference for makeup and eyewear choices.
notable: Primary result plus secondary shape possibilities for mixed features
Analyzes eyelid crease, outer-corner angle, and inter-eye distance
Framed as a beauty and style reference, with makeup and eyewear suggestions
caveats: Not a medical measurement, per the page
